title: DARE: Diverse Visual Question Answering with Robustness Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by varying the number of correct options (from 0 to 4) and testing different output formats (e.g., JSON, CSV, exact word) to measure the models' reliance on formatting biases and their pretraining bias toward single-correct multiple-choice setups.

Measuring Vision-Language Model (VLM) performance on visual question answering tasks featuring images of important concepts rooted in different cultures, which are approximated by five languages (Chinese, Swahili, Tamil, Turkish, and Indonesian).
